info.name: TurboLedger — Phase 4 (Customer domain)
info.description:
Phase 4 surface through the API Gateway: clients (core CRUD, commands, sub-resources), client addresses, clients v2 search, and collateral management (Customer service).

Run the '0 - Auth' request first (requires a tenant/admin already provisioned) to populate {{token}}. Collection variables: baseUrl, tenantId, token.

Request bodies were auto-derived from the actual field reads in CustomerService.cc; placeholder values are generic and should be adjusted to valid data (e.g. real office/staff ids) for your environment.

Note: 'command' routes accept any Fineract client command (activate, close, reject, withdraw, reactivate, etc.) via the {cmd} path segment — the example defaults to one such command and includes the union of fields used across all command branches; trim the body to just the fields relevant to the command you choose.
